title: InformationSystemComponent
description: An identifiable architectural constituent of an information system that encapsulates a defined responsibility, structure or execution boundary and participates in the composition or operation of that information system. Abstract kind (D-2 disposition 2026-10-16; CR-019); the concrete ApplicationComponent and IntegrationComponent specialise this kind. The kind covers all first-class IS architectural constituents: it is not merely a technology product, software package, or deployment resource. The ApplicationComponent (APC) and IntegrationComponent (IGC) specialisations retain their component_type discriminator for EGV-004 identity continuity and for catalog search/filter use cases that predate the abstract ISC introduction. Specialises dea:SolutionComponent (the abstract parent kind per ADR-0002 D3). Relationship connections (composition, execution, dependency, service provision, interface exposure) are expressed via the canonical relationship vocabulary (dea:composes, dea:executes, dea:depends-on, dea:provides, dea:exposes) and are not duplicated as inline relationship state on this entity, per CR-3 (no entity contains a relationship that is also independently represented as a relationship instance).

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).
